membershipBasis: Numeric source names normalized to registered dong suffix, exact registered road and parcel, equal floors and height difference <=1m when present (missing source and zero registered height retained as unknown), within1000m of official point. Root verified actual SQLite geometry/properties and raw register rows. Complex membership is inference; no cadastral or named-complex polygon boundary proof. Generic compound grouping is not membership evidence.
limitations: Only identified source buildings receive copies; unmatched or unnamed sources remain unchanged.
Representative photograph does not establish tower number or compass face; exterior is complex-photo inference.
Height may be estimated from registered floors only when no source or register height is available; estimates are not measurements.
Clones repeat representative shape and facade/floor pattern; exact target concavity and per-floor differences are not reconstructed.

Unique numeric source within300m of identified local complex matched exact registered road/parcel/dong; membership inferred without cadastral proof. Source nulls remain unknown; registered height used.

supplementalReview.basis: Regional exact numeric source; registered exact road/parcel/dong; unknown OSM height/floors retained. No individual photo claim for siblings.
